components.note: 鸟 (bird) — marks birds, as in 鸡 chicken, 鸭 duck; 鹅 is the goose, as in 企鹅 penguin.
我 (wǒ) — only a loose sound hint (é vs wǒ); same part in 俄 é and 饿 è.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 喻 is saying one thing in terms of another, as in 比喻 metaphor.
俞 (yú) — close sound: 喻 yù. 俞 also sounds out 愉 yú and 偷 tōu.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water, as in 海 sea, 河 river; 湖 is a lake.
胡 (hú) — same sound: 湖 hú. 胡 also sounds out 糊 hú and 蝴 hú.
刂 (knife) — marks cutting and dividing, as in 别, 刻; 剂 is a measured dose, as in 药剂 medicine.
齐 (qí) — loose sound hint (jì vs qí); 齐 also means even, fitting a measured dose.
钅 (metal; traditional 金) — marks metals, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron, 铜 copper; 铅 is lead, as in 铅笔 pencil.
干 (dry, shield) — a net 罒 over 干: 罕 first meant a hunting net; it now means rare, as in 罕见 seldom seen.
犭 (animal; 犬 dog) — marks animals, as in 猫 cat, 猪 pig, 狗 dog; 狩 is hunting, as in 狩猎.
守 (shǒu) — close sound: 狩 shòu. 守 also sounds out 兽 shòu, which is also an animal word.
力 (strength) — 劣 is weak, little strength 少 + 力; poor in quality, as in 恶劣 bad and 劣质 inferior.
少 (few) — 少 + 力: a little strength, so weak or inferior.
目 (eye) — marks the eyes and seeing, as in 看 look, 睛 eye, 盯 stare; 眨 is blinking, as in 眨眼.
乏 (fá) — loose sound hint (zhǎ vs fá); 乏 means lacking, as in 缺乏.
钅 (metal; traditional 金) — marks metals, as in 钱, 铁; 钩 is a hook made of metal.
勾 (gōu) — same sound: 钩 gōu. 勾 also sounds out 沟 gōu and 构 gòu.
兑 (duì) — exchanging or cashing in, as in 兑现 to honour a promise. The part 兑 also sounds out 说 shuō, 税 shuì and 脱 tuō.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 啊 is an exclamation.
阿 (ā) — same sound: 啊 ā.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 哦 is an interjection of understanding.
我 (wǒ) — loose sound hint only (ó vs wǒ).
讠 (speech; traditional 言) — marks speaking and questions, as in 说 say, 请 ask; 谁 is the question word who.
隹 (zhuī, short-tailed bird) — loose sound hint (shéi); 隹 also sounds out 堆 duī and 推 tuī.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嘿 is a greeting or exclamation, hey.
黑 (hēi) — same sound: 嘿 hēi. 黑 means black.
又 (right hand) — a picture of a hand, now used for again, as in 又来了. Same hand appears inside 友 friend, 取 take, 双 pair.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嗯 is a sound of agreement or acknowledgement.
恩 (ēn) — same sound: 嗯 ēn.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 噢 is an interjection of sudden realization or pain.
奥 (ào) — loose sound hint (ō vs ào).
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嗨 is hi or hey, a greeting.
海 (hǎi) — close sound: 嗨 hāi; same part as in 海 sea.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 呃 is a hesitation sound, uh, or a hiccup.
厄 (è) — same sound: 呃 è. 厄 also sounds out 扼 è.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push; 搞 is a flexible verb for doing or handling something.
高 (gāo) — close sound: 搞 gǎo. 高 also sounds out 稿 gǎo and 糕 gāo.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嘛 is a particle added to a sentence for emphasis or persuasion.
麻 (má) — same sound: 嘛 má. 麻 also sounds out 吗 ma, the question particle.
去 (qù) — close sound: 却 què. The 卩 on the right was once a kneeling person; 却 means retreat, then but.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 喂 is a hello on the phone or a call for attention; also to feed.
畏 (wèi) — same sound: 喂 wèi. 畏 also sounds out 煨 wēi.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 哇 is an exclamation of surprise, wow.
圭 (guī) — loose sound hint (wā vs guī); same part in 挂 guà and 娃 wá.
亻 (person) — marks people; 俩 is two people, as in 咱俩 the two of us.
两 (liǎng, two) — same sound family: 俩 liǎ is a contraction of 两个 two people.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 拉 pull, 推 push; 挺 is straightening up and sticking out, then very, as in 挺好.
廷 (tíng) — same sound: 挺 tǐng. 廷 also sounds out 庭 tíng and 艇 tǐng.
木 (tree) — a mouth 口 on a tree 木: standing stiff and blank like a tree; 呆 means dull or to stay put, as in 发呆.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 喔 imitates a crow or is an interjection, oh.
屋 (wū) — loose sound hint (ō vs wū).
口 (mouth) — wrapping 勹 around 口: a mouth-sized group of words, so a sentence, as in 一句话 one sentence.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 啥 is the colloquial what, as in 干啥 doing what.
舍 (shè) — close sound: 啥 shá.
辶 (walk, 走之) — marks movement and roads, as in 过 pass, 进 enter; 遍 is going all over, then times, as in 看一遍.
扁 (biǎn) — close sound: 遍 biàn. 扁 also sounds out 编 biān and 偏 piān.
犭 (animal; 犬 dog) — marks animals, as in 狗 dog, 猪 pig, 狼 wolf; 猫 is the cat.
苗 (miáo) — close sound: 猫 māo, like a cat's meow; 苗 also sounds out 描 miáo.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 拉 pull, 提 lift; 挂 is hanging something up.
圭 (guī) — close sound: 挂 guà. 圭 also sounds out 鞋 xié and 娃 wá.
石 (stone) — marks stones, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break; 砸 is smashing with something hard.
匝 (zā) — same sound: 砸 zá.
山 (mountain) — marks hills and heights, as in 峰 peak; 岛 is a mountain rising from water, an island.
辶 (walk, 走之) — marks movement; 逼 is pressing someone in, as in 逼近 close in and 逼迫 force.
畐 (fú) — loose sound hint (bī vs fú); same part sits in 福 fú and 副 fù.
欠 (yawn, lack) — a person with an open mouth yawning; now means to owe or lack, as in 欠钱 owe money. As radical it marks mouth actions like 吹, 歌.
自 (nose) + 犬 (dog) — a dog's nose smells; 臭 originally meant smell, now stink, as in 臭味.
页 (head) — head-shaped things; 颗 is a measure word for small round things like grains, pearls and beads, as in 一颗星.
果 (guǒ) — loose sound hint (kē vs guǒ); 果 also means fruit, a round thing.
糸 (silk thread) — piled-up threads: 累 is to accumulate, and what builds up wears you out, so tired, as in 累积.
目 (eye) — marks the eyes and looking, as in 看 look, 眼 eye; 盯 is fixing one's gaze.
丁 (dīng) — same sound: 盯 dīng. 丁 also sounds out 钉 dīng and 订 dìng.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground; 堆 is a pile of earth, then any heap.
隹 (zhuī, short-tailed bird) — loose sound hint (duī); same part in 推 tuī and 谁 shéi.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 咬 is biting.
交 (jiāo) — loose sound hint (yǎo vs jiāo); 交 also sounds out 校 xiào and 胶 jiāo.
巾 (cloth) — marks cloth and flags, as in 布 cloth, 帽 hat; 帅 once meant a commander under a flag, now also handsome.
足 (foot) — marks feet and walking, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump, 路 road; 踢 is kicking.
易 (yì) — loose sound hint (tī vs yì); same part sounds out 锡 xī and 赐 cì.
身 (body) — marks the body, as in 躲 hide, 躬 bow; 躺 is lying the body down.
尚 (shàng) — loose sound hint (tǎng vs shàng); same part in 堂 táng, 常 cháng and 掌 zhǎng.
大 (big) with four 爻 marks — an open, airy feel; 爽 is crisp, refreshing and frank, as in 凉爽 cool and refreshing.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嘘 is exhaling or hushing.
虚 (xū) — same sound: 嘘 xū. 虚 also sounds out 墟 xū.
犭 (animal; 犬 dog) — marks animals, as in 狗 dog, 猫 cat; 猪 is the pig.
者 (zhě) — close sound: 猪 zhū. 者 also sounds out 煮 zhǔ and 著 zhù.
